evidence: Carries the P2P label and adds the NODE_UTXO_SET service bit and new P2P wire messages to query and fetch snapshot chunks.
rationale: Adds in-band P2P distribution for AssumeUTXO snapshots according to a draft BIP, significantly lowering onboarding friction for users currently forced to acquire snapshots out-of-band. Protocol extension requires deliberate review of DoS vectors and network resource usage.
